# Lanesra OS

Lanesra OS is a modern, open-source sales and business management application for small businesses.

## Current status

- Early Access v0.13.0
- Browser-based live demo is available, including a working Admin panel
- Windows desktop edition is in early development: the source is public today (Tauri + Rust + SQLite) with the full sales lifecycle, Contracts, Tasks, user management, Team Workspace mode for small teams (Docker), backup/restore, self-service password change, PDF generation and printing, and CSV import/export all working. An unsigned Early Access Windows installer (.exe/.msi) is available from GitHub Releases; build and run from source is also supported.
- Also shipped: an Admin panel giving admins broad control without code changes - user & role management, an editable business profile (name, phone, address, logo), branding and print customization, reports beyond the dashboard plus a simple custom report builder (group by any field including custom fields, count or sum), custom fields on every major object (Companies, Contacts, Opportunities, Quotes, Orders, Invoices, Contracts, Products, Tasks), conditional business rules and workflow automation across those same objects, admin-configurable ID/numbering formats per object (choose the prefix and digit width, e.g. "ACC-000001" or "ACC-ab0001"), and a dashboard KPI picker.
- Next up: a code-signed installer and task reminder notifications.

## Core capabilities

- Companies and contacts
- Opportunities and sales pipeline
- Products and services
- Quotes, orders and invoices
- Contracts
- Tasks and activities
- Sales dashboards with an admin-configurable KPI selection
- Connected relationship validation
- Admin-configurable record numbering (custom prefix and digit width per object)
- Admin panel: users & roles, business profile, custom fields, business rules, workflow automation, numbering, dashboard KPIs

## Product principles

- User ownership of business data
- Offline-first desktop direction
- Connected records instead of duplicated free text
- Simplicity before feature volume
- Open-source transparency
- Modern, accessible product design
